description.value: Porter's Bistro & Coffee House occupies a heritage building in the Murrayville neighbourhood of Langley that has served the community since 1888, retaining its original floors, fixtures, and cabinetry. The bistro serves hot breakfasts, house-made lunch items, and fresh-baked goods from an on-site bakery each morning. It also hosts a long-running weekly open mic night on Thursdays, making it a lively community landmark that draws both locals and travellers.
